card.name: Separators in lists of arthritis conditions
card.fires_on: Commas and 'and'/'or' that join items in a list of disease names, mostly inflammatory arthritis and skin conditions, in dosing-by-indication headings. It also fires on a few linking words before a condition name.

modes.label: Comma or 'and' in indication lists
modes.description: The separator sits between names such as rheumatoid arthritis, atopic dermatitis and ankylosing spondylitis.
modes.example: Rheumatoid Arthritis , Psoriatic Arthritis , Atopic Dermatitis<< ,>> Ankylosing Spondylitis ,

modes.label: Linking word before a condition
modes.description: A short word like 'with' or 'for' leads into a named condition or population in a dosage heading.

card.plain: It fires on the comma or 'and' between disease names in a list of conditions a drug is used for.
